purpose: Opening title and subtitle for a video or a chapter.
accessibility: The title and the optional subtitle are the only content. Colour and size come from the theme (task 019); the subtitle uses the muted text token, a theme pair that meets WCAG AA. Long text wraps inside the safe area and scales down within the theme's type scale (title to body, subtitle to body); below body size it is a validation warning. Over footage, a theme scrim (task 039) keeps it legible.
